stageStudio.description: Use dark play surfaces and a light management studio.

classic.description: The original quiz loops during answers.
classic.title: Classic

techno.description: Full techno pack: a techno bed during answers plus techno UI and podium cues.
techno.title: Techno

show.title: Show
show.description: A generated score that follows the round: quiet while reading, a drop when answers open, and a hit for the verdict. It climbs a little each question.

visuals.globalDefaultHelp: This is the global default background for games that do not set a quiz override.
visuals.uploadLimits: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF up to 5 MB.

full.title: Full
full.description: Light and sound hits that fill the whole frame, a spotlight on the most-picked answer, and the full score.

calm.title: Calm
calm.description: No full-frame hits, spotlight or beams. The verdict happens on the tile. Music 12 dB quieter, with no groove while answering.

silent.title: Silent
silent.description: Calm, with no audio at all.
